label: Calamonastes_simplex
summary: The grey wren-warbler (Calamonastes simplex) is a species of bird in the family Cisticolidae. It is found in Angola, Burundi, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Malawi, Rwanda, Somalia, South Sudan, Tanzania, Uganda, and Zambia. Its natural habitat is dry savanna.

appearance.colors: The grey wren-warbler (Calamonastes simplex) is a species of bird in the family Cisticolidae. The grey wren-warbler is a shy bird found in dense bush and undergrowth.
